title: Suez: a connection can close
hook: Does opening a canal make its connection permanent?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: The physical channel was not a permanently available connection.

claims.text: 1859: Construction. Digging begins near today’s Port Said.
1869: Opening. The canal opens between two seas.
1975: Reopening. The canal reopens to navigation.

The physical channel was not a permanently available connection. After opening in 1869, Suez closed following the 1967 war and reopened in 1975. Maps of infrastructure need time as well as geometry: a line on a map does not guarantee an open route. Construction also depended on Egyptian labor under harsh conditions.
Canal geometry is schematic; the closed frame shows interruption, not disappearance.
